comments.author: xqjG

HOLDING the draft until the Thermite read returns (named mechanism template). Then: draft via the design affordance -> cold review -> operator ratification.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
RED TEAM ESCAPE ANALYSIS (design v2, 2 adversaries, Opus 4.8) — BOTH return golden_path_verdict = NOT-THE-EASY-PATH. This challenges the design core, correctly.
MASTER FINDING: every now-built v2 control is detection-only, non-blocking, surfaced through a vsdd status poll — while ALL real enforcement seams (Layer-4 install/hooks, Layer-6 gates, Layer-7 conformance, #816 mdatron) are downstream/unbuilt. During the bootstrap window v2 targets, it REBUILDS THE EXACT CORPUS TOPOLOGY: a record a human must read, caught by the operator, never by a control. The six-round collapse re-runs identically. And the incentive gradient still favors deviation: for every flagship escape (hand-roll design, fix-in-place, phase-compress) the deviation stays cheaper than compliance because nothing FORCES the compliant path; bootstrap format-carries are conventions the contract itself says fail because they depend on the agent choosing to comply.
BLOCKING ESCAPES: (1) detection-only = advisory, not enforcement, in bootstrap [both]; (2) the keystone audits every OTHER mechanism but nothing audits whether the AUDIT ran — it is exempt from its own discipline (absence of a poll leaves no trace) [A]; (3) the incentive gradient points away from compliance [B]; (4) the "non-bypassable Layer-6 backstop" is a commit-time gate skippable via --no-verify (true non-bypassability needs server-side CI) [A].
SUBSTANTIVE ESCAPES: disposition-closure exemption = universal routing bypass (relabel fix-closes as consolidated/dismissed); fix-with-no-owning-finding is invisible to routing detection (the June narration pattern); state.yaml composition is agent-authored so "tamper-evident" is a category error (git proves authorship not truth); routing edge checked for PRESENCE not correctness (attach to any target); pin --update re-pin passes the drift gate without re-review; phase-transition gate reads self-authored records; SELF-MODIFICATION — the agent edits the detection scripts (managed artifacts it can also edit); an unwired instance control is a silent aggregate gap; done-conditions are self-authored 2-fixture tests.
KEY BUILDABLE-NOW FIX (Adversary A): bind the now-built detection to a FIRED seam that exists today — a session-stop hook that runs status and non-zero-exits on any new integrity finding, and/or the existing git pre-commit refusing a governed-set commit while an unrouted/ungated finding stands — so deviation produces compiler-shaped feedback, not a latent record. Absent that, mark the increment honestly as ADVISORY, not enforcement. This reopens dogfood decision (A): a forcing seam IS buildable now (the repo already has a pre-commit), so detection-only-without-a-seam was the wrong scoping.
Folding into v3 with the terminal-verify + the wider-eval #817 (still running).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
V3 TERMINAL VERIFY — 3/3 needs-another-round; Red Team golden_path STILL not-the-easy-path. THE DECISIVE FINDING (Red Team verified against the actual repo): v3s load-bearing correction — the now-built controls bind to forcing seams that EXIST TODAY — is FALSE AS BUILT. Repo facts: .githooks/pre-commit runs mdatron verify on staged markdown/schema/pattern files only and exits 0 for source commits (a .rs fix commits with ZERO checks), and mdatron has no tracker/finding/routing/gate awareness, so it CANNOT refuse a governed-set commit while an unrouted/ungated finding stands; NO session-stop/SessionEnd hook exists anywhere; the crosslink sentinel (the REQ-1 heartbeat) is enabled:false; .vsdd/state.yaml does not exist. The seam has nothing to force on and is not wired — the advisory-not-enforcement gap the prior adversaries flagged, papered over by a factual misstatement about the built system rather than closed.
OTHER BLOCKERS/SUBSTANTIVE: SA — the escape-vector table marks unrouted-findings Enforced-now, contradicting the live-dormant admission (the query needs the Layer-6 tracker-join). Security — REQ-7 says git is a truth leg not agent-editable, contradicting REQ-2 git-leg-is-rewritable; tamper-evidence-by-corroboration is otherwise substantially real. Heartbeat per-act half under-specified + sentinel disabled. Minors: delta overstatements (fix-with-no-owning-finding is ALREADY a ratified contract falsifier, line 83; compiler-shaped feedback is already the contract goal, Summary line 10); disposition-rate is a heuristic; filing-timestamp is agent-controllable locally.
THE CONVERGED TRUTH (three adversarial rounds): there is NO forcing seam today; making the golden path the easy path requires BUILDING enforcement, and the routing/finding disciplines genuinely cannot be enforced now because their Layer-2 tracker-join is dormant until Layer 6. Only the LIVE-DATA disciplines (git-resolved phase-gate/boundary-commit; commit-evidence owning-finding; refs/session-substrate) are enforceable-now, and only if a real seam is BUILT (the existing pre-commit does not do it). This reopens dogfood decision (A): bind-to-a-seam requires BUILDING the seam, not wiring an existing one.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: PAUSED to feed a re-decomposition (operator direction 2026-07-28). The v3 terminal verify + both Red Team passes converged on a STRUCTURAL root cause: the horizontal component layers defer the enforcement substrate (esp. the tracker-join the Layer-2 queries need) to the back third, so enforcement is never live-early and every now-enforcement claim fails. The fix is not another design iteration against the current structure — it is a phase-1c RE-DECOMPOSITION to vertical capability slices (each buildable AND enforceable end-to-end). This design (#815) becomes an INPUT to that re-decomposition: its escape corpus, the forcing-seam finding, the live-dormant finding, and the enforcement-needs-live-data-early conclusion are the drivers. #815 resumes (or is superseded) after the re-decomposition ratifies. The #818 shipped-vuln fixes proceed independently (defect lane; Fix 3 done).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
Thermite architecture study (agent report 2026-07-28); filed dollspace-gay/Thermite#93 for its enforcement drift. Lessons for #815 (the tamper-proof / grade-4 half):
1. Tool-allowlist-per-role IS real grade-4 — Claude Code refuses an ungranted tool (verified: acto-critic lacks Edit). BUT a capability fence is only as strong as the FULL residual set: Thermite's critic still holds Write+Bash, so its 'read-only' is grade-1 convention, not capability. A genuine read-only critic must withhold EVERY mutation tool (drop Write, constrain Bash) or run on a read-only mount. This is precisely WHY #815's tamper-evidence-by-corroboration half stays necessary — it covers the residual Write/Bash surface a porous fence cannot.
2. Add a LIVENESS axis orthogonal to the 4 grades: a designed grade is worthless if de-wired. Thermite's two edit-time gates silently died (commit 5581b65f) and every doc still claims them live. The meta-harness must ROUTE ITS OWN CONTROL PLANE (settings.json, agent defs) — a gate that guards the gates. Directly reinforces the vsdd draft's own 'route the control plane' instinct.
3. Split grade 2: 2a commit/push-time (records a deviation) vs 2b edit-time PreToolUse (prevents the edit) — 2b is closer to grade-4 in effect and still substrate-portable; a sweet spot for controls that can't be grade-4.
4. Match doc claims to enforced reality mechanically. Thermite's goal.md R-SIDE-1/R-BV-1 'forward-looking — not yet enforced' labels are the good model; make 'enforced' a checked property (a test asserting the claimed wiring exists).
